headline: Over 100 infected with anthrax across five districts in Bangladesh
summary: Outbreaks in Gaibandha, Meherpur, Rangpur, Dinajpur, and Kushtia linked to the consumption and handling of infected livestock meat.
details: Over 100 people have been infected with anthrax across five districts in Bangladesh over the last two months. The affected areas include Gaibandha, Meherpur, Rangpur, Dinajpur, and Kushtia.

Over 100 people infected with anthrax across five districts in Bangladesh.

Over 100 people have been infected with anthrax across five districts in Bangladesh over the last two months. The affected areas include Gaibandha, Meherpur, Rangpur, Dinajpur, and Kushtia.
